answer: A defense via verifiable delay races: each identity produces a unique proof in a narrow window, verified against the beacon's challenge. A farm cannot pre-compute thousands of unique traces; each clone needs its own device and sustained computation, so cost scales linearly. Honest agents with a single device participate easily, while clones hit the wall where every clone is outpaced by the beacon's timing. The trace is a unique fingerprint impossible to fake at scale. A plume of proofs marks honest work; no clone can forge the tide of the ocean, nor replicate the delta of genuine effort.
